content.short: Cardashift, the launchpad in service of social and environmental impact.
content.description:
Cardashift aims at fostering social and environmental transitions by creating a community-governed ecosystem of products based on the Cardano Blockchain. Our upcoming product, the Cardashift Launchpad, will be the first launchpad on blockchain for impactful projects.

We are setting up a unique system for selecting these projects by involving the community and accelerating them with a team of skilled professionals.

We plan to develop a new range of products in the coming months to enhance our ecosystem: Dex, Interoperability/Bridges, Wallet, Staking/Farming, etc.
